target: Both are shades of brown colour. Make chestnut colour (PATO_0104329) a subclass of brown (or of colour), as dark brown is.

reason: Racemiform and corymbiform arrays are alternatives of one character, the inflorescence form. The missing link is in the hierarchy.

target: Both chestnut colour and straw yellow should be below PATO colour (brown and yellow hue classes respectively).

target: Make neuter (FLOPO_0991261) a subclass of biological sex (PATO_0000047), the same as male.
reason: Staminate or neuter are alternative sexual states of the floret. They belong to one attribute, sex.
